representations.name: entropy-coded point-private bipartitions
representations.new_information: Separates the number q+1 of line incidences from the O(log q) private-prime coordinates needed to encode them.
representations.first_test: Count nontrivial unordered bipartitions of r primes and bound the largest point odd part when all primes are below q^6.

representations.name: fixed-product exponent code
representations.new_information: Tests whether q incident factor pairs can be encoded with a constant number of point primes and complementary exponents.
representations.first_test: Optimize the exponent range and compare its bit cost q log q with the K-bit host budget.

representations.name: projective-plane line cluster
representations.new_information: Converts a pairwise-one-point-intersecting incidence design into exact matching and transversal parameters.
representations.first_test: Recompute nu=1 and tau=q+1 while allowing q to grow faster than K.

representations.name: affine and partial-plane comparators
representations.new_information: Tests whether fewer points or labels can preserve a large blocking number with matching number one.
representations.first_test: Check whether parallel lines create disjoint supports or whether deleting line classes destroys the desired transversal scale.

representations.name: prime-supply versus bit-budget ledger
representations.new_information: Tracks separately the number of globally private primes and the logarithmic size contributed by each selected prime.
representations.first_test: Use pi(q^6) asymptotics and derive an explicit O((log q)^2) upper bound for every raw odd part.

representations.name: smooth composite label compression
representations.new_information: Tests replacement of private primes by smaller pairwise-coprime composite labels without losing valuation separation.
representations.first_test: Measure whether global coprimality and q+1 line codes actually reduce the maximum logarithmic label cost.

representations.name: integer padding flow polytope
representations.new_information: Views powers-of-two corrections as an integer load-balancing problem with one total-demand constraint and per-vertex capacity.
representations.first_test: Bound the discrepancy Delta and prove a maximum decrement of four when q>K.

representations.name: multi-prime padding comparator
representations.new_information: Tests whether distributing correction among several padding primes enlarges q beyond the square-root logarithmic scale.
representations.first_test: Compare the extra state space with the unchanged odd-part coding bottleneck and verify support distinctness.

representations.name: dyadic monotone embedding
representations.new_information: Retains exact band and transversal information when transferring a power-of-two construction to arbitrary N.
representations.first_test: For K=floor(log_2 N), prove (2^K/32,2^K] is contained in (N/64,N] and compare the two stretched-exponential bounds.

representations.name: disjoint cluster packing
representations.new_information: Tests whether many smaller clusters can improve a global transversal lower bound while retaining the frozen single-cluster intersection property.
representations.first_test: Check whether unions of clusters still have matching number one and pairwise one-point intersections.
